title: Kinhold Update: First look at combat!
author: SweetKarmaz
selftext: Kinhold is being made with Claude Code. Started working on real combat - this is a test with an enemy raider and a players villager. This is a test of the bow animations, the arrow projectiles, triggering an enemy even with missing, and switching to melee automatically. Also, you can see some loot dropped when the enemy died. Still a lot of work to do, and after cleaning this up, we are going to work on the enemy raid system before working on enemy settlements!
